name: TC_PLT_API_USER_02 Verify that regular User can search plants by name via API
fullName: TC_PLT_API_USER_02 Verify that regular User can search plants by name via API

steps.name: Given User "testuser" is authenticated with password "test123"
request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/auth/login', body: { username: 'testuser', password: 'test123' }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
assert expected **200** to equal **200**
Given Plants "Rose Red", "Rose Pink", and "Tulip" exist in the database
request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/auth/login', body: { username: 'admin', password: 'admin123' }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
wrap Object{4}, Object{4}, Object{4}

request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/plants/category/2', body: { name: 'Rose Red', price: 50, quantity: 5, category: [Object] }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiI'... 121 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
log Plant Rose Red likely already exists (Status 400). Proceeding.

request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/plants/category/2', body: { name: 'Rose Pink', price: 60, quantity: 8, category: [Object] }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiI'... 121 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
log Plant Rose Pink likely already exists (Status 400). Proceeding.

request ("{ method: 'POST', url: '/api/plants/category/2', body: { name: 'Tulip', price: 70, quantity: 12, category: [Object] }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJhZG1pbiI'... 121 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")
log Plant Tulip likely already exists (Status 400). Proceeding.
assert expected **200** to equal **200**
When I send a GET request to "/api/plants/paged" with parameters:

DataTable 
| name | Rose |
| page | 0    |
| size | 10   |

request ("{ method: 'GET', url: '/api/plants/paged', qs: { name: 'Rose', page: '0', size: '10' }, auth: { bearer: 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ0ZXN0dXN'... 124 more characters }, failOnStatusCode: false }")

DataTable  
| name | Rose |
| page | 0    |
| size | 10   |
Then The response status code should be 200
assertexpected 200 to equal 200
assert expected **200** to equal **200**
And The response body should contain plants with "Rose" in the name
assertexpected Rose Red to include Rose
assertexpected Rose Pink to include Rose
assertexpected Rose to include Rose
assert expected **Rose Red** to include **Rose**
assert expected **Rose Pink** to include **Rose**
assert expected **Rose** to include **Rose**
